title: Axis My Zone Easy (FD) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A secured, fixed-deposit backed entry-level credit card that lets you earn rewards and get basic lifestyle perks like movie cashback and dining discounts while helping build or improve your credit profile.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 15% off up to INR 500 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.offer: ₹120 off per order using "AXIS120".|Valid for twice a month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the EazyDiner app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 15% savings at 10,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your Axis My Zone credit card to unlock the offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: This offer can be availed 2 times in a month.
